content: Hi .. we recently enabled the enable-pid-failure-log feature flag in our QA and Prod sites .. and I see logs being created. I did a bunch of testing with various methods of requesting an invalid DOI. I've noticed that in Dataverse 6.10.1, failed lookups via /api/datasets/:persistentId are logged, but failed lookups via /dataset.xhtml?persistentId=... are not. Is this the intended behavior, or should the UI landing page also generate PID failure log entries?
Hmm, #11601 says "request some non-existent datasets/files by PID using the JSF interface and/or API" so it should work.
@Deirdre Kirmis do you mind opening an issue?
